title: Unable to delete a schedule event when a program has only one event.
description: When attempting to delete a schedule event from a program that contains only one event, the application displays an error message and prevents the deletion, even though the UI indicates the delete action is possible.
steps: Create a new program with at least one lighting event (e.g., 'Sunrise' or 'Sunset').
Navigate to the list of programs.
Select the created program to edit it.
Tap the trash can icon next to the single existing lighting event.
Observe the 'Unable to Delete' dialog box, stating 'Cannot delete when only one schedule event exists'.
actual: When a program has only one lighting event, tapping the delete icon for that event displays a dialog box with the message 'Unable to Delete' and 'Cannot delete when only one schedule event exists'. The event is not deleted.
expected: When a program has only one lighting event, the delete icon should either be disabled or, if tappable, should present a confirmation dialog. If the user confirms deletion, the event should be removed, and the program should be saved.
